project-a-ventures._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md s8): one company rendered under different names across Project A's surfaces (the live Sanity CMS, the 2020-2024 Contentful records, the 2015-2019 Kirby/LogoTile pages, the 2012-2014 WordPress gallery) and its renames. Where the Contentful record id is the same across names, the id is cited. Written at kickoff 2026-09-30 (PRO-102), before the first grind build.

merges.reason: one company: WorldRemit (the firm's 2014-2024 listings, Series A 2014) renamed its group Zepz in 2021; the live CMS lists Zepz

merges.reason: one company: one Contentful record (id 6iNbiMsdql3FDmWHqDxBwk) renamed Electric Playbox (2020), Electric Gamebox (2021-22), Immersive Gamebox (2022-24)

merges.name: Bene Bono

merges.name: Keatz

merges.name: Flow AI

merges.name: Scenset

merges.name: Evino
merges.reason: one company: Epicerie (the firm's 2013 gallery: 'an innovative online wine business, founded in February 2013 by Ari Gorenstein and Thais Felippi in Sao Paulo') renamed Evino in 2014; epicerie.com.br redirected to evino.com.br by April 2015 (archived capture), and the firm's Evino record gives the same founding month and city
